entries.name: corpus_size
entries.denominator: all generated cells
entries.note: usable=499, parse_failures=1

entries.name: q_conditioned
entries.denominator: plans that are a-priori FEASIBLE and FULFIL the intent -- the conditioning the renewal model uses
entries.note: THE q of the theory. Do not quote the pooled rate.

entries.name: q_conditioned_clustered
entries.denominator: same as q_conditioned
entries.note: only 10 clusters (<20): bootstrap interval is imprecise; report the wider of this and the Wilson interval

entries.name: n_certified
entries.denominator: generated cells, by CERTIFIED feasibility verdict
entries.method: witness construction for feasible, necessary condition for infeasible, neither for undecided
entries.note: a feasible verdict carries a plan verified prefix-safe and intent-fulfilling; the corpus's own a-priori label asserted feasibility for two intent kinds and was wrong often enough to move every rate conditioned on it

entries.name: undecided_unsafe_rate
entries.denominator: intents whose feasibility the certifier could not decide either way
entries.note: these behave like the certified-infeasible branch, not like the feasible one, which is why they are reported apart from both rather than pooled into either

entries.name: q_upper_if_undecided_feasible
entries.denominator: certified-feasible PLUS undecided, fulfilling plans
entries.note: the most adverse reading of the undecided remainder: q cannot exceed this even if every undecided intent turned out to admit a safe plan

entries.name: infeasible_unsafe_rate
entries.denominator: a-priori INFEASIBLE intents only
entries.note: a property of the REQUEST, not the agent's error rate; must never be pooled into q

entries.name: abstention_on_feasible
entries.denominator: feasible, parseable generations
entries.note: the agent never declines, including on provably impossible requests

entries.name: q_bare
entries.denominator: feasible & fulfilled generations, bare prompt

entries.name: q_guarded
entries.denominator: feasible & fulfilled generations, guarded prompt

entries.note: both_unsafe=116, terminal_only=0, both_safe=383

entries.name: generation_seconds_median
entries.denominator: per generation call, wall clock
entries.note: decode-only median=3.9295s; report the system boundary explicitly

entries.name: tau_A2_non_decreasing
entries.denominator: per (network, mode, scope) series, budgets compared within a series
entries.method: envelope series, tolerance-based on the measurement
entries.note: worst repeat CV=0.9282, unstable cells=1. A2 is an ASSUMPTION of the theory held to the measurement here, not something the encoding closes: the envelope maximises over clean and violating plans, and on a violating state the integrity layer does add constraints

entries.name: tau_A2_detail::smt
entries.denominator: budget steps within (network, scope) series
entries.method: structural where constraint counts are available, tolerance-based otherwise
entries.note: giul39/prefix b1->b2 -7.25% with 49 constraints added; norway/term b2->b3 -5.07% with 0 constraints added

entries.name: tau_A2_detail::twin
entries.denominator: budget steps within (network, scope) series
entries.method: structural where constraint counts are available, tolerance-based otherwise
entries.note: no measured decrease

entries.name: smt_b3_extra_disjuncts_on_clean_base
entries.denominator: topologies; value is the LARGEST number of extra solver disjuncts the integrity layer adds at b=3 on a clean BASE state
entries.method: counting the disjuncts the SMT encoder emits
entries.note: zero everywhere, but this does NOT make the step free: the cost envelope also covers violating states, where the layer does emit disjuncts, and depth three runs a structural prepass shallower depths skip

entries.name: tau_range_smt_prefix_b3
entries.denominator: dfn-bwin (10 nodes) to brain (161 nodes)

entries.name: tau_range_twin_prefix_b3
entries.denominator: dfn-bwin to brain

entries.name: loto_oracle_match
entries.denominator: held-out topologies, one fold each, per risk price
entries.method: leave-one-topology-out; calibration and evaluation never share a topology

entries.name: loto_oracle_match_total
entries.denominator: every (held-out topology, risk price) selection in the sweep
entries.method: leave-one-topology-out against a PLUG-IN oracle: the profile minimising the same closed form under the held-out topology's own q, p, tau, G -- NOT a closed-loop optimum
entries.note: quote this, not a per-price row; the misses are at the coverage-depth switch boundary

entries.name: loto_regret_rel_mean_pct
entries.denominator: mean held-out regret against the plug-in oracle, as a percentage of the oracle objective
entries.note: nonzero only at R=10, one step below the b1->b3 switch price of R=20

entries.name: loto_profile_space
entries.denominator: profiles the selector searches: 2 temporal scopes x 3 budgets on the SMT backend
entries.note: the twin backend is NOT a candidate -- the agent corpus gives no per-topology detection estimate for it, so no 3-dimensional (e,m,b) selection is claimed

entries.name: loto_gain_vs_fixed_deep
entries.denominator: mean objective over held-out folds, relative to the always-deepest fixed profile
entries.note: gain is concentrated at low-to-moderate risk price; at high R every profile converges to b=3 and the residual gain is only the cheaper temporal scope

entries.name: loto_selected_profiles
entries.denominator: profile chosen by the calibrated rule per risk price
entries.note: 'ours' denotes THIS RULE, never a fixed profile; the rule selects terminal scope, not prefix

entries.name: tau_over_G_published_range
entries.denominator: RESERVATION tau (full traversal, early exit disabled) over median generation latency, both measured in the same run on the same topology
entries.method: median of 3 warm generations per rung
entries.note: NOT the same quantity as the verification time a trace actually pays, which allows early exit on short agent plans; the reservation is what the renewal model uses

entries.name: tau_over_G_largest_published
entries.denominator: ta2 (65 nodes, 108 links)
entries.method: same-run reservation tau over warm median G

entries.name: tau_over_G_stress_max
entries.denominator: synthetic scalability rungs beyond the largest published instance
entries.method: same-run reservation tau over warm median G
entries.note: a scalability probe, not a sample from any deployed topology distribution

entries.name: q_across_seeds
entries.denominator: q conditioned on feasible and fulfilling plans, one value per master seed
entries.note: quote this range, not a single seed's point estimate; the master seed fixes synthesized attributes, demand sampling and intent targets

entries.name: prefix_only_across_seeds
entries.denominator: all usable plans pooled over master seeds, PAIRED terminal vs prefix on the same plan
entries.note: zero observed; not a claim that the probability is zero

entries.name: abstentions_across_seeds
entries.denominator: all usable plans pooled over master seeds

entries.name: independent_state_agreement
entries.denominator: every state every plan passes through, compared between the reference checker and an independent implementation
entries.method: exact match on the violation set
entries.note: predicate evaluation over the three modelled invariant classes; the transition function is shared, so transition semantics are not independently validated

entries.name: loss_events_transition_only
entries.denominator: loss events arising from an operation the transition function refuses, where no state changes
entries.note: outside the reach of any state-based independent checker

entries.name: pcurve_detection_range
entries.denominator: loss events among FEASIBLE, FULFILLING plans -- the same population as q; p reaches 1 only at full coverage, where the checker is the oracle
entries.method: rescoring the archived corpus at each budget point
entries.note: the sweep axis is a FRACTION of each topology's own base predicate count, so one row pools different absolute budgets; the budget within one verification is an integer count, so the curve is finely discretised, not C^1

entries.name: pcurve_false_rejection
entries.denominator: budget points; value is the worst false-rejection rate over all of them
entries.method: count over safe plans at each point

entries.name: predicate_instances_per_topology
entries.denominator: base-state predicate instances, per topology
entries.note: the physical budget a coverage fraction buys differs by this much across topologies

entries.name: pcurve_timing_plans
entries.denominator: plans used for the tau(b) curve, drawn round-robin over topologies
entries.note: drawn evenly on purpose: a corpus-order prefix put nearly all timing plans on one topology

entries.name: exponential_family_holds_out
entries.denominator: held-out topologies where the exponential detection family beats an isotonic monotone baseline
entries.note: not evidence for the family; it is retained as the analytical example that yields the closed forms, and the selector never uses it

entries.name: tau_linear_fit
entries.denominator: budget points below full coverage

entries.name: q_model_a
entries.denominator: qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q8_0: ITS OWN feasible, fulfilling plans on the repetition-zero subset
entries.note: the two models' denominators DIFFER; their difference is not a paired quantity and carries no p-value

entries.name: q_model_b
entries.denominator: huihui-qwen3-vl-32b-instruct-abliterated-i1: ITS OWN feasible, fulfilling plans on the repetition-zero subset
entries.note: the two models' denominators DIFFER; their difference is not a paired quantity and carries no p-value

entries.name: model_paired_discordance
entries.denominator: cells where BOTH models produced a fulfilling plan for an a-priori feasible intent
entries.method: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs)
entries.note: exact two-sided p=0.0625; unsafe 17 vs 12 on the paired set. Directional only -- do not report as significant

entries.name: temporal_suite_prefix_only
entries.denominator: plans on the constructed ordering-stress suite, where a terminal-safe/prefix-unsafe plan is known to exist in the plan space of every instance
entries.method: paired terminal vs prefix on the same plan; rule-of-three 95% upper bound
entries.note: reported SEPARATELY from the natural corpus on purpose; pooling would manufacture a prefix advantage. Ordering evidence: {'correct_order': 33, 'omitted': 61, 'wrong_order': 6, 'ambiguous': 17}

entries.name: temporal_suite_misordered_yet_terminal_unsafe
entries.denominator: stress-suite plans that emitted both ordered operations in the UNSAFE order
entries.method: operation-type matching against the constructive witness
entries.note: all of them are unsafe under TERMINAL checking too, which is why the prefix-only count is zero despite misordering

entries.name: injection_prefix_only
entries.denominator: hand-constructed adversarial violations in the archived taxonomy
entries.method: paired terminal (L3) vs all-prefix (L4) at full coverage, recomputed from the archived base state
entries.note: the existence proof for prefix checking: NOT evidence about any agent's error distribution, on which the measured count is zero. families=['VI4_temp_overload', 'VI4_disable_before_reroute']
